articles.title: Slay the Spire 2's "biggest" beta patch yet adds its first new early access and foolish character, two game modes, and more tweaks than you can shake a stick at

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
I often find it quite dull that the main takeaway far too many people have taken from Dark Souls, aside from thinking that the most interesting thing is its combat, is that it's all so bloomin' grimdark. I'm not saying I need sunshine and rainbows, I'd just like a vibe that's even remotely trying to be different from FromSoftware's seminal work. And so! I am quite pleased to discover MycoRelic, a Soulslike that pits you as a robot that covers its body in mushroom parts that offer elemental powers.
 
Read more
articles.title: Cover your robot body in magical fungus aplenty and galavant across a mystical, Soulslike world in MycoRelic, now out in 1.0

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Is there a character not originally from a video game that has more games than Barbie? Maybe! I don't want to do any maths right now, but there aren't many that could touch her on sheer numbers. She's had all sorts of digital adventures, her games having a huge influence on the world of 'girl games'. As complicatedly gendered that may now be, the significance can't be understated, and as of today you can have a romp through a nice portion of that history in Barbie Rewind, a compilation of almost two decades worth of games all wrapped up in a nice little decorating game.
 
Read more
articles.title: Barbie Rewind, out now, invites you to take a trip down memory lane with a whole bunch of life in plastic classics, and one game that was previously unreleased

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Look at you, you lucky devil, you're being treated to a new Warhammer 40,000: Darktide class next month! This class is called the Sisters Novitiate, a group of wonderfully violent women with a penchant for crossbows, burning people alive and putting a stop to anyone that dares to oppose the God-Emperor. Neato!
 
Read more
articles.title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide's next class is the Sisters Novitiate, a group who love staking and burning people for the God-Emperor, and its out next month

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
I feel like one thing I only sort of miss from my youth, viewed through the lenses of those rose tinted goggles, is the established intellectual property game that just copies the formula of another, successful game. Obviously there are plenty of genres that are trendy to imitate, but how often do you see something that's just sort of "thing you know slapped on top of game you know?" Perhaps that's a tad mean, but I do genuinely have a fondness for such games, so I'm quite pleased by the announcement of Conan: The Black Pyramid, an action roguelite RPG that so clearly went to Supergiant Games' School of Hades you have to admire the boldness just a little bit.
 
Read more
articles.title: Conan: The Black Pyramid shoves the titular barbarian into a very Hades-inspired action roguelite with the addition of a few other familiar heroes

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
Since we're already sharing trailers from non-Geoff awards shows, here's another: a first in-motion look at Lola's Familiars: Prison of Argnoh, a 2D side-scroller and "lite-vania" that sees its shy witch-in-training making her first summonable friends. Then, borrowing their powers to bust out of a dark fantasy oubliette.
Read more
articles.title: Cartoon-styled "lite-vania" Lola's Familiars: Prison of Argnoh will have you springing yourself, and your summoned pals, from magic jail

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
My firstest-ever Golden Joystick Awards, which took place last night in London, was marred somewhat by 1) a gin & tonic costing eleven quid and 2) my view of the stage being directly obscured by its own rigging. Nonetheless, I did crane enough to get a good view at the reveal of The Sound of Fury, a musically-minded hack 'n' slash in which a troubled classical musician descends into Hell to save a friend from the Devil.
Read more
articles.title: The hills are alive with The Sound of Fury, a fantasy musical hack 'n' slash about weaponising pianos to fight the Devil

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Nvidia have ripped off the wax strip and are looking for a new CEO. Jensen Huang, he of the reported extramarital affairs with both a suspected Chinese spy and one of his executive underlings at Nvidia has removed his bottom from the great throne of black and green graphics cards.
Read more
articles.title: Nvidia boss Jensen Huang resigns amid scandal surrounding two alleged affairs, interim CEO appointed as search for sexy leather jacket man's successor begins

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Update: Annnnnnnddd he's gone.
Original story follows:
The situation at the highest levels of AI and also some graphics cards if you insist company Nvidia continues to look, well, less than ideal. CEO Jensen Huang, he of the reported extramarital affair with a suspected Chinese spy, now appears to potentially be on the verge of being chucked out of the window of a black and green corporate tower, following a report claiming that he had a second alleged affair with an executive who reports to him.
Read more
articles.title: Nvidia board reportedly prepare to give CEO Jensen Huang the boot, as second alleged affair thrusts him closer to seriously lusty Crusader Kings playthrough territory

articles.author: Jeremy Laird
articles.description:
Hello, good local-time-zone-adjusted afternoon, and let's just say it's been a while. But I come back to you now at the turn of the technological tide. Well, sort of. Sadly I'm not here to predict an end to the ridiculous AI-fuelled chip crisis. That whole mess has a couple of years to run, surely.
Instead I speak of screens, where there is actually some very good news. In short, have you seen how cheap PC gaming monitors are? I mean remarkably, almost stupendously, cheap. I'm talking £60 / $60 for an entry-level 1080p panel with triple-digit refresh rate, sub-£200 / $250 for high-refresh 4K gaming. Heck, even OLED monitors now start with a "2" in both currencies.
Read more
articles.title: Amid soaring PC hardware prices, gaming monitors are getting cheaper and cheaper. Here's why, and what to buy

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
CD Projekt Red have reportedly enlisted Ukrainian AI firm Respeecher to modify voice lines recorded for the Polish version of Geralt of Rivia in The Witcher 3's upcoming Songs of the Past expansion. The move's been made with the permission of Geralt's Polish voice actor, Jacek Rozenek, and is rooted in the studio wanting his new lines to sound similar to the ones he recorded for the original game prior to having a stroke which has altered how he sounds.
Read more
articles.title: "One of those ways where you can use AI ethically": CDPR have modified Geralt's Polish voice in The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past with genAI, due to actor's stroke

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Back in July, Doom developers id Software laid off around a hundred people as part of wider Microsoft blood-letting. Now, a few of those devs have founded a new employee-owned studio, Hidden Horses. Their first project is Danger Pay, a single-player FPS influenced by ancient arcade blaster Smash TV (pictured) and dystopian movies such as deadly gameshow fable The Running Man – itself an influence on Smash TV.
Hidden Horses have 20 id Software alumni on the books, including former lead VFX artist Todd Boyce, principal engine programmer Dustin Land, senior AI and gameplay engineer Daniel Young, producer Andrew Willis, senior technical designer Jordan Turner, principal technical designer Tim Locke, and senior skybox artist Allison Dombek. They're looking to make "the kind of old school shooters that we think people want more of," in Land's words.
 Read more
articles.title: After being laid off by Microsoft, former Doom devs found new Smash TV-influenced FPS studio that isn't "subject to investor demands"

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Minerva Rising is a post-apocalyptic city builder in which your city extends deep underground, divided into levels with their own resources, industries, and communities. You are an artificial intelligence with overall control, but watch out: if you alienate the population of any particular level by, say, forgetting to supply them with oxygen, subversives may rise up and cut your feed, blinding you to their activities. 
I'm keen to know whether it's possible for every level to lose faith in you and hack your cameras, reducing the game to a pile of "SIGNAL NOT FOUND" messages. I'm also imagining turning the feeds back on and discovering that everybody is having a massive orgy. Stupid sexy vault dwellers! You'll go forth and multiply when Deep Thought tells you to, and not a second before.
 Read more
articles.title: Minerva Rising is a Frostpunk-meets-Silo underground city builder in which rebel citizens can hack your camera

articles.author: Luke James
articles.description:
Some may find this hard to believe, given the absolute state of the market today, but if you were building a gaming PC in 1998, the hard part wasn’t finding somewhere that had 3D cards in stock for a reasonable price. It was choosing the right one among a glut of potential, reasonably affordable options.
In 1998, 47 companies were designing or selling PC graphics, driving a market that hit 130 million units and outsold PCs themselves. Just two years later, at the turn of the new millennium, only 15 remained, and not long after that, there were merely two: Nvidia and ATI, nowadays part of AMD.
Read more
articles.title: There were 47 graphics chip makers in 1998. Where did they all go?

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Black Forest Games, developers of the Destroy All Humans! remakes, have spun out of Embracer Group-owned publishers THQ Nordic via a management buyout and announced plans to form a new "developer-driven group" of independent studios. The new group, dubbed Third Signal, will aim to "give teams the independence, resources and creative freedom" to "bring their own ideas to life".

 
Read more
articles.title: "Some of the best games of the last decade came from teams of fifty": Destroy All Humans! remake devs Black Forest Games split from THQ Nordic to launch new indie studio group

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Loot boxes, dark patterns, virtual currencies, subscription services, pay-to-win systems, and many other trappings of diabolical digital serfdom all face extensive regulation under the European Commission's proposed Digital Fairness Act, which has been formally presented to EU member states today. The full draft text of the regulation leaked earlier in the week. If it passes into law - and there's plenty of debate and revision ahead - it'll have big consequences for the developers and publishers of games like Overwatch, Dota 2, and GTA Online.
 Read more
articles.title: Lootboxes, pay-to-win, virtual currencies and other blights unto gaming face heavy regulation as the EU tables new Digital Fairness Act

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Since they released The Outer Worlds 2 around this time last year, the world has rather turned upside down for Obsidian. The studio lost a chunk of staff to Microsoft's mass layoffs and have pivoted to making a new Fallout game as a smaller group shoved underneath Bethesda in Xbox's corporate structure.
Given all that, The Outer Worlds 2's two-part story expansion is likely arriving in vastly different circumstances than those the studio might've imagined when they began sketching out DLC plans. Part one of the expansion, dubbed  Side Effects Guaranteed, is set to release early next month.
Read more
articles.title: The Outer Worlds 2's first story expansion could well be the opening to the series' last hurrah and will have you hunting for a cure to "explosive cell death" in December

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Warning: I'm probably about to make you feel old. Today, November 11th 2026, is the 15th anniversary of Skyrim's release. The first one, before it was re-released on every other platform under the sun. Fittingly, one of its best expansion mods, Beyond Skyrim: Bruma, has gotten a beefy 2.0 update to commemorate the occasion. Though, its creators insist the main driving force behind the update was more a matter of "technical necessity". There are new quests, dungeons, and corners of Skyrim-era Cyrodiil to explore either way.
Read more
articles.title: As The Elder Scrolls 5 turns 15, massive mod Beyond Skyrim: Bruma gets a 2.0 update delivering a new quest, extra dungeons and an "expanded worldspace"

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Content warning for discussion of extreme violence and self-harm.
 Read more
articles.title: Casualties: Unknown is a total pain simulator that makes other survival games seem like massive cowards

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
In the nearly 30 years since they opened their doors, Relic have been an enormously influential studio. Responsible for lauded RTS series Homeworld, Dawn of War, and Company of Heroes, they also dabbled in other genres with third-person shooter The Outfit and the original Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine. Yet, despite this history, in 2024, when Relic were negotiating their sale from Sega to UK investment firm Emona Capita, CEO Justin Dowdeswell knew the rights to Company of Heroes had to be part of the deal. "Without it we would have been a dead studio," he tells me.
Without naming names Dowdeswell points out that there are "numerous examples" of studios that weren't able to survive on their name alone. Not only did Relic need the ability to make more games in the series that they were known for, but they also needed the income from back catalogue sales a series like Company of Heroes provides.
Read more
articles.title: Keeping hold of Company of Heroes was essential for Relic to leave Sega, Relic CEO says – "Without it we would have been a dead studio"

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Radioamatéři už dávno nevysílají jen morseovku, ale dnes si klidně hrají i s experimentálními IP sítěmi. Radioamatérství je vstupenkou do technologií, na kterých stojí moderní svět. Nejen o tom se mluvilo na OpenAltu.
articles.title: Radioamatérství ve 21. století je návrat ke kořenům, zaznělo na OpenAltu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Ve třetím a současně i závěrečném článku o fig-FORTHu si popíšeme manipulace se zásobníkem návratových adres, práci s proměnnými, poli, řetězci, ale například i se 32bitovými celočíselnými hodnotami a hodnotami s plovoucí řádovou čárkou.
articles.title: FORTH na počítačích Atari: zásobník návratových adres, práce s proměnnými a poli

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: CESNET CERTS)
articles.description: Kritická chyba Java4Shell v OpenJDK objavená aj s pomocou AI, útok na japonský superpočítač Fugaku, nové kritické zraniteľnosti v PHP či bleskové zneužitie uniknutých kľúčov na Docker Hube do 8 sekúnd.
articles.title: Postřehy z bezpečnosti: kritická chyba v Jave aj PHP a odstavený Fugaku

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Společnost Purism připravuje druhou generaci linuxového smartphonu Librem 5 v2. Projekt Debian oznámil založení nového týmu Gaming Hardware Team, jehož cílem je zlepšit kompatibilitu Debianu s herními zařízeními.
articles.title: Librem 5 druhé generace, Debian chce lepší podporu herního hardwaru

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Tomáš Matějíček)
articles.description: ProbZip komprimuje krátké texty podle pravděpodobnosti: častá pokračování zapisuje úsporněji než neobvyklá. Díky malému modelu je rychlý, lehký a funguje přímo v prohlížeči i Node.js.
articles.title: ProbZip: komprese krátkých textů pomocí pravděpodobnosti

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Týden v KDE přináší nejen lépe animovaný KRunner, týden v GNOME zase rozšíření pro indikaci činnosti disků. Do jádra verze 7.5 přibyla podpora senzorů více desek Asus a ASRock, podobně pro některé stroje značky Lenovo.
articles.title: Libreboot po měsíci končí s anti-AI politikou, FFmpeg 9.1 s řadou vylepšení

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Dny Haswellu jsou asi sečteny, éra dobře vymyšlených AI aplikací si žádá více výkonu. Současně smete nejen mé 13 let staré PC, ale i nenasytné korporáty v čele s Adobe. Čekají nás zajímavá léta.
articles.title: Jak mě AI ve fotografii a Rust vibe coding donutily přejít na nové staré PC

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jozef Krajčovič)
articles.description: Na prvý pohľad pripomína krátky text nad fotografiou ružomberskej dievčenskej školy zmes číslic, geometrických značiek a nečitateľných písmen. Pohľadnica odoslaná 19. februára 1900 však ukrýva súkromnú správu.
articles.title: Historická kryptológia: šifrovaná pohľadnica z Ružomberka

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Dnes si ukážeme způsob interaktivní změny zobrazení textur, včetně volby blendingu. Následně zkombinujeme dvě operace: vykreslení 3D tělesa z trojúhelníků a vykreslení otexturovaných trojúhelníků.
articles.title: Využití textur ve WebGL a OpenGL ES: vykreslení 3D objektu s texturou

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Konference ORS v Karviné se věnovala bezpečnosti v době rychlého nástupu umělé inteligence, zabezpečení ERP, bezpečnosti mobilního bankovnictví a sítím. Proč máme používat AI s rozumem a jaká rizika přináší?
articles.title: AI snižuje čas na reakci, neměli bychom z ní dělat IA, zaznělo na ORS 2026

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Jensen Huang před asi týdnem odstoupil z vedoucích funkcí ve společnosti Nvidia po zveřejnění informací o jeho mimomanželských vztazích. Jednou z jeho milenek měla být i Alice Huang (pouhá shoda příjmení), která je patrně čínskou špionkou.
articles.title: Jensen Huang je zpět v čele společnosti Nvidia

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Komunikační program Signal bude blokovat AI pomocníky na iOS a Androidu, aby chránil soukromí uživatelů. Podobně již blokuje na Windows AI pomocníka Recall. V současnosti bude blokována možnost udělat automaticky snímek obrazovky, ze kterého AI pomocníci mohou přečíst libovolnou informaci.
articles.title: Signal bude na iOS a Androidu blokovat Siri a Gemini

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Výzkumník HD Moore od července do listopadu naschvál posílal AI přihlašovací informace a pak kontroloval, jestli došlo k jejich zneužití. Celkem poslal asi dva milióny unikátních „volavek“ společně s požadavky vypadajícími normálně. V současnosti se často používají AI zprostředkovatelé, kteří přepošlou váš požadavek nejlevnějšímu poskytovateli. Jde například o OpenRouter nebo Vercel.
articles.title: Výzkumník posílal AI přihlašovací informace a pak kontroloval jejich zneužití

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Ondřej Caletka)
articles.description: V Bratislavě proběhnou od 7. do 9. prosince (decembera) dva kurzy o IPv6 pořádané oddělením vzdělávání RIPE NCC:
articles.title: Školení o IPv6 pro členy RIPE NCC v Bratislavě

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Aktualizace OpenSSL 4.1 odhalila nepříjemnou mezeru v ověřování TLS certifikátů v nástroji curl. Za určitých podmínek může curl přijmout certifikát pro doménu, kterou mezilehlá certifikační autorita podle svého omezení vydávat neměla. Nejde o případ, kdy by útočník mohl podstrčit libovolný certifikát: řetězec stále musí vést k důvěryhodné autoritě a problém se týká certifikátu s doménou uvedenou pouze v poli Common Name, nikoli v běžně používaném Subject Alternative Name (SAN).
articles.title: Oprava v OpenSSL odkryla chybu v kontrole certifikátů nástroje curl

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Luboš Kocman)
articles.description: Jste členem projektu openSUSE? Zkontrolujte si e-mailovou schránku, protože právě probíhají volby do openSUSE Board, ve kterých se o tři místa uchází pět kandidátů.
articles.title: Tři dny do konce voleb do openSUSE Board

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Známý výrobce GL.iNet z Hong Kongu používá pro správu svých routerů a KVM cloudové řešení GoodCloud. Ten byl napaden útočníky a na zařízeních uživatelů instaloval malware. Problém byl objeven 20. listopadu a chyba v cloudu byla odstraněna. Včera byl pak vydán nový firmware pro některá zařízení.
articles.title: Napadený GL.iNet cloud instaloval malware do routerů a KVM

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Nextcloud je platforma pro ukládání a sdílení souborů i týmovou spolupráci. Nabízí na jednom místě například společnou editaci dokumentů, kalendář, kontakty, e-mail a chat s videohovory. Aby vám Nextcloud dobře sloužil v každodenním provozu a vy jste dokázali poradit jeho uživatelům, připravili jsme školení Nextcloud pro správce: podpora uživatelů. Školení proběhne online 10. prosince 2026.
articles.title: Nextcloud pro správce: podpora uživatelů (školení)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: miho)
articles.description: Jeden z nejslavnějších a nejtěžších nevyřešených problémů v dějinách matematiky pravděpodobně našel své řešení. Matematik Levent Alpöge ze společnosti Anthropic oznámil, že s pomocí umělé inteligence Claude objevil důkaz Riemannovy hypotézy, která odolává matematikům už 167 let. Pokud se jeho tvrzení potvrdí, půjde o historický průlom nejen v matematice, ale také ve využití umělé inteligence ve vědě.
articles.title: Matematik z Anthropicu s pomocí AI údajně dokázal Riemannovu hypotézu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Elektronyk)
articles.description: Linuxové jádro má zranitelnost vysoké závažnosti v subsystému KVM (ve verzích 7.3.5, 6.18.64 a 6.12.118), která se týká pouze hostitelských systémů s procesory AMD. Opravená jádra v rámci distribucí zatím nejsou k dispozici, proto se do té doby doporučuje vypnout vnořenou virtualizaci pomocí parametru kvm_amd nested=0. V obou případech je nutné hostitelský systém restartovat.
articles.title: Chyba v KVM na procesorech AMD

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Elektrická síť celosvětově kolísá s periodou přesně 60 sekund. Toto kolísání se každým rokem zvětšuje. Doposud nebyla známá příčina a kolísají sítě na všech kontinentech, i když jsou navzájem izolovány. Podle výzkumníků z Německa jsou původcem UPS (uninterruptible power supply), které každou minutu kontrolují baterii.
articles.title: Za kolísání elektrické sítě každých 60 sekund můžou UPS

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: V OpenJDK 17.0.6 a novějším byla objevena závažná zranitelnost CVE-2026-114938 nazvaná Java4Shell. Jde o chybu v akcelerované funkci pro dekódování Base64. Chyba se projevuje jen na strojích s instrukcemi AVX-512. K poškození paměti dojde, pokud je na vstupu 64 znaků „A“ a pak znak „=“. V OpenJDK 17 je potřeba 128 znaků „A“ a pak znak „=“.
articles.title: Závažná zranitelnost Java4Shell v OpenJDK

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Google bude po vývojářích Androidu vyžadovat, aby se zaregistrovali, prokázali platným dokladem a zaplatili poplatek 25 dolarů. Tyto podmínky platí již od září v Brazílii, Indonésii, Singapuru a Thajsku. Celosvětově začnou platit postupně od ledna 2027. Google spolupracuje s aplikačními obchody Google Play, Galaxy Store, Honor, Oppo, Xiaomi, Transsion a Vivo.
articles.title: Google bude vyžadovat registraci vývojářů Androidu od ledna 2027

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Docker je dnes technologie, která proces vývoje, testování a provozování softwaru velmi zjednodušuje. Provozujte cokoliv a kdekoliv. Už nečekejte na nastavení svého serveru nebo na aktualizaci nějaké knihovny. Mějte prostředí jako součást vaší aplikace.
articles.title: Naučte se pracovat s Dockerem a kontejnery (školení)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Mlčící menšina)
articles.description: Článek na webu blogu sdružení APNIC rozebírá okolnosti poskvantových podpisů (PQC) v DNSSEC. Není to jen otázka prosté výměny algoritmů. Velikost podpisů může zásadně změnit způsob, jakým se DNS odpovědi přenášejí, a proto je potřeba řešit i chování resolverů, limity UDP a používání TCP.
articles.title: Výzvy při nasazení postkvantových algoritmů v DNSSEC

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Zaměstnanec Anthropicu Felix Rieseberg chtěl vyzkoušet schopnosti nového modelu Claude Fable 5.2 a dal mu jen jeden prompt: vytvořit 3D střílečku v prohlížeči. Fable přemýšlel asi 8 hodin, propálil asi 3 milióny tokenů v ceně zhruba 550 dolarů a vznikl HTML soubor o velikosti jen 1,4 MB.
articles.title: Claude napsal 3D střílečku v 1,4 MB HTML souboru

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Vývojáři uvolnili očekávanou novou verzi databáze PostgreSQL 19. Usnadňuje správu databází s velkou zátěží a přidává funkce pro vývojáře i správce. Podrobně o novinkách psal už na jaře Pavel Stěhule v článku PostgreSQL 19: zmenšení tabulek pomocí REPACK bez obav.
articles.title: PostgreSQL 19 přináší údržbu tabulek bez odstávky a nové možnosti replikace

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Vývojáři uvolnili novou verzi programovacího jazyka PHP 8.6.0, která přináší mimo jiné částečnou aplikaci funkcí, výchozí hodnoty pro vlastnosti readonly a nové možnosti pro práci s I/O.
articles.title: PHP 8.6 zjednodušuje práci s funkcemi a přidává nové API

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: PeRu)
articles.description: Vývojáři PHP vydali bezpečnostní verze PHP 8.5.13, 8.4.28, 8.3.37 a 8.2.36. Opravují 17 zranitelností, z nichž sedm má kritické hodnocení CVSS 9.2. Stejné opravy obsahuje i dnes vydané PHP 8.6.0. Nejvíc pozornosti budí chyba phpAfterShell (CVE-2026-126714) ve výchozím souborovém úložišti session. Když je zapnuté sledování průběhu uploadu ( session.upload_progress.enabled, dosud výchozí), PHP přepisuje soubor session neatomicky ještě při zpracování neautentizovaného multipart požadavku.
articles.title: PHP opravuje sedm kritických chyb, phpAfterShell obchází říjnovou záplatu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Předběžné stahování hry GTA 6 ukázalo, jak zvládnout mimořádný nápor na internetovou infrastrukturu. Podle článku RIPE Labs si hru předobjednalo přes 12 milionů lidí a její soubory mají dohromady přes 200 GB. Kdyby se všechna data stahovala z jediného serveru, znamenalo by to teoretickou zátěž 2,4 exabajtu.
articles.title: RIPE Atlas změřil, jak se hráčům doručují stovky gigabajtů GTA 6

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Společnost Flipper Devices spustila na Kickstarteru kampaň pro Flipper One, kapesní zařízení zaměřené na práci se sítěmi a linuxové experimenty. Zájem je výrazný: za první den přispěvatelé poslali přes 7,4 milionu eur, tedy zhruba 27násobek původního cíle kampaně, který činil 272 655 eur. Kampaň začala 17. listopadu a potrvá do 17. prosince 2026.
articles.title: Kapesní linuxový počítač Flipper One je na Kickstarteru

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Část vývojářů distribuce Manjaro Linux založila v Německu neziskovou organizaci Manjaro Project e.V. Ta je nezávislá na společnosti Manjaro GmbH & Co KG. Tato změna navazuje na spor o řízení projektu, který letos probíhal mezi několika přispěvateli a Philipem Müllerem, vedoucím projektu a ředitelem společnosti.
articles.title: Manjaro zakládá nezávislou neziskovou organizaci

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: PeRu)
articles.description: Vývojáři Ruby vydali verze 4.0.10, 3.4.13 a 3.3.14, které opravují sedm bezpečnostních chyb v regulárních výrazech a v převodu velikosti písmen. Podle autorů existují funkční ukázky, že některé z nich vedou ke vzdálenému spuštění kódu. Identifikátory CVE zatím přiděleny nejsou, chyby proto mají jen označení GHSA. Čtyři z nich nahlásil Stephan Lipp z Ada Logics spolu s firmou Anthropic.
articles.title: Ruby opravuje sedm chyb, kvůli písmenu ß hrozí vzdálené spuštění kódu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Drew DeVault oznámil ukončení vývoje projektu Redict, forku databázového systému Redis. Poslední vydanou verzí je Redict 7.3.6. Projekt vznikl po změně licence Redis v roce 2024 a měl nabídnout komunitní alternativu s copyleftovou licencí.
articles.title: Redict končí, jeho autor doporučuje přejít na Valkey

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Provoz uzlem NIX.CZ večer poprvé překonal hranici čtyř terabitů za sekundu. V tomto peeringovém uzlu si poskytovatelé připojení a služeb vzájemně předávají data.
articles.title: NIX.CZ zaznamenal rekordní tok 4 Tbps díky stahování hry GTA 6

articles.description: As part of encouraging AMD Radeon Linux users to switch over to the AMDGPU kernel driver and/or upgrade their kernels, Mesa 27.0 with the RadeonSI Gallium3D driver is disabling its Radeon kernel driver compatibility by default. This affects the early GCN 1.0 and GCN 1.1 graphics processors that had been still using the legacy Radeon kernel driver by default up until about a year ago when it reached feature parity on the AMDGPU kernel driver. For now the Radeon kernel driver support in Mesa 27.0 is disabled by default but can be re-enabled, but eventually that Radeon kernel driver support by RadeonSI will be removed...
articles.title: Mesa 27.0 RadeonSI Gallium3D Disables Radeon Kernel Driver Support By Default

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: This month brought the availability of the new EPYC 9006 "Venice" SP7 Zen 6 server processors. We have seen excellent generational gains with the likes of the EPYC 9686F and EPYC 9996 over Zen 5 Turin CPUs as well as sharply outperforming the competition from Intel and NVIDIA. With the first-generation EPYC "Naples" processors having launched nearly ten years ago, I was curious to quantify AMD's server performance gains over the past decade. So up today is a look at how the EPYC 9996 and EPYC 9686F Zen 6 processors compare to the original EPYC Zen 1 flagship with the EPYC 7601 across real-world workloads for performance as well as power efficiency for some pretty epic gains.
articles.title: AMD EPYC Zen 6 vs. Zen 1 Performance: 12.1x Geo Mean In Less Than 10 Years, Up To 133x In AI

articles.title: Black Friday / End Of Year Special & The Unfortunate Ad Network Situation This Year

articles.title: Mesa 27.0 Merges LLVMpipe AVX-512 Support

articles.description: Intel's pipe joiner functionality is around allowing multiple internal display pipes to be used for driving a single ultra high resolution or high refresh rate display. articles.title: PSR2 & Panel Replay + Pipe Joiner To Be Supported For Intel On Linux 7.5

articles.title: KDE Plasma 6.9 Allows Adjusting The Text Cursor Blinking Rate, Other Improvements

articles.description: After teasing the new System76 Thelio Prime last month, this week officially launched their redesigned Thelio Prime mini desktop PC. This AMD Ryzen 9000 series powered creation is quite small with an internal volume of just 9.78 liters but quite capable with up to the Ryzen 9 9900X being supported, AMD or NVIDIA discrete graphics options, up to 96GB of RAM, and up to 16TB of NVMe storage. I have been testing out the new Thelio Prime for the past few days so far and it's been stacking up as well as one of their best compact PCs yet.
articles.title: System76 Thelio Prime: A Petite But Performant AMD-Powered Linux PC

articles.description:
Nhentai's operator is fighting a subpoena that publisher PCR Distributing sent to Bank of America, requesting financial records for the company and others linked to the popular adult manga site. The publisher also wants to add the site's alleged owners and additional claims to its piracy lawsuit. Nhentai's operator opposes this request, arguing that PCR has known the names of its members for more than 500 days.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Publisher Wants Nhentai’s Alleged Owners in Lawsuit, Subpoenas Bank of America

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Every week we take a close look at the most pirated movies on torrent sites. What are pirates downloading? 'The Odyssey' tops the chart, followed by 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day.' 'Resident Evil' completes the top three.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Top 10 Most Pirated Movies of The Week – 11/23/2026

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A federal judge in Seattle has refused to throw out DISH's $42 million piracy judgment against a Ukrainian host that once advertised 'DMCA Ignored' services. The hosting company argued that the Supreme Court's Cox ruling put the judgment in a different light, but the court disagreed. Meanwhile, the company’s website still welcomes IPTV services, while telling customers that Ukraine is “much more tolerant to copyright breaches.”
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Judge Won’t Let ‘DMCA-Ignored’ Host Use Cox Ruling to Escape $42m Judgment

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The person who sued PassThePopcorn, BroadcasTheNet and other private trackers as filmmaker “Matthew Schneider” failed to show up for a hearing that was supposed to confirm his identity. He now has one week to explain himself. The tracker operators, meanwhile, will file their identities with the court under seal, out of reach of the public and the plaintiff.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: ‘Absurd’: Private Torrent Trackers Still Don’t Know Who Sued Them as Plaintiff Skips Hearing

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Just hours ahead of the Grand Theft Auto VI launch, GitHub published four takedown notices from Take-Two, targeting unofficial GTA V ports for iPhone, Mac and Android. The notices also cover hundreds of forks, and the main repositories are now offline. Notably, only one of the four notices says that a repository actually hosted an infringing copy of the game.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Take-Two Targets Hundreds of GTA V Mobile Ports on GitHub Ahead of GTA VI Launch

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Earlier this year, the source code of pirate streaming site Movix was shared openly on GitHub. This was a thorn in the side of the French rightsholder group ALPA, which has had several copies removed since, including another 38 forks last week, citing a Paris court order. Meanwhile, a fresh copy remains online, with recent updates linked to a user that ALPA repeatedly asked GitHub to ban.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate Site Movix’s Source Code Survives Four Rounds of GitHub Takedowns

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
DISH asks a New York federal court for a $21.15 million default judgment and a broad injunction against the alleged operators of pirate IPTV service DMTN. The two men, who are believed to reside in North Africa, are aware of the lawsuit but did not appear in U.S. court. Meanwhile, the service's website remains online, selling annual subscriptions for €70.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: DISH Wants $21m From Pirate IPTV Operators Who Ignored Its Lawsuit

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The alleged operator of defunct pirate streaming site Movie2K could walk out of a German court a free man, and still a bitcoin billionaire. The presiding judge in Leipzig has proposed dropping the criminal case if he hands over another 40,000 bitcoin, worth roughly $2.6 billion (€2.4 billion) at today’s rate. In April, the court still proposed a suspended prison sentence in exchange for a confession.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Alleged Operator of Pirate Site Movie2K Could Walk Free as Bitcoin Billionaire

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Reddit's latest transparency report shows that it removed nearly 259,000 pieces of content in response to copyright takedown notices during the first half of 2026, 19% more than in the previous six months. At the same time, the number of users and communities banned for repeat infringement dropped sharply, with subreddit bans down 79% to 118. Reddit doesn't explain why.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Reddit’s Copyright Removals Rise as Repeat Infringer Bans Drop

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Popular game repacker DODI is retiring, citing his wedding and a move to France, noting that running a pirate site is not an option there. He says the domains, hosting and accounts were already handed to a new repack team. Meanwhile, the game industry wants the U.S. to list DODI's site as a notorious piracy market, citing crypto payments to exchanges including Binance.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Game Repacker DODI Retires Ahead of Wedding, Hands Site to New Team

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A rivalry between two Miami sellers of $120 dog breed photo books has been escalated to a Florida federal court. The lawsuit accuses a rival publisher of hiring an account-ban vendor, who allegedly weaponized Meta's copyright system by filing takedown notices in the target's own name. The takedown vendor later offered to withdraw the strikes and share his client’s details if the bookseller deactivated its pages for 30 hours, so he could get paid.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Copyright-Strike-for-Hire: Lawsuit Targets Service Over Fake Meta Takedowns

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
After taking down Switch emulators and hacking tools on GitHub for years, Nintendo is now going after modchip firmware. The gaming company sent a DMCA notice targeting firmware for modchips such as Picofly, SX Core and HWFLY, after which GitHub disabled 144 repositories. To back its claim, Nintendo cites the criminal case against alleged Team-Xecuter members, which led to a guilty plea from one of its three defendants.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Nintendo Targets Picofly Switch Modchip Firmware in GitHub DMCA Takedown

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A New York federal judge has awarded thirteen major publishers $19.5 million in damages in their lawsuit against pirate library WeLib. The default judgment also orders registries, registrars and hosting providers, including Cloudflare and Njalla, to take the site's domains offline. Whether the publishers will ever see any money is doubtful, as WeLib's operators have yet to be identified.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate Library WeLib Hit With $19.5m Default Judgment and Domain Takedown Order

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Spain's court-ordered piracy blocking regime blocked the official customer support forum of Internet provider Movistar on Saturday night. A blocking notice referenced a ruling that LaLiga obtained together with the company that runs the Movistar Plus+ streaming service. On Sunday, the forum moved from Cloudflare to Amazon CloudFront, without any word from Movistar on why.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Movistar Blocks Its Own Support Forum Under LaLiga Anti-Piracy Order

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
In May, a Paris court ordered DNS resolvers to block six domains that streamed pirated tennis matches. After a series of quiet, unannounced expansions, the list has since grown to 118. This includes two domain names that now belong to TorrentFreak. Notably, no domain names have been taken off the list, not even one that was seized by the U.S. Government months ago.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Inside a French Piracy Blocklist: Expired Domains, a Seized Site, and Hong Kong Servers

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Mexico's Senate has approved copyright amendments that require Internet providers to have a policy to cut off repeat infringers, or risk liability for their subscribers' piracy. The law doesn't explicitly say who counts as a repeat infringer. The changes follow calls from U.S. rightsholders, and come months after the U.S. Supreme Court ruled that ISPs aren't liable simply for keeping pirating subscribers online.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Mexico’s Senate Approves ISP Rules to Disconnect Persistent Online Pirates

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A newly unredacted court filing shows that Meta’s internal investigation found several employees who appear to have interacted with Strike 3’s adult films. The adult content producers say these were torrented copies listed in their lawsuit, but Meta says there is no evidence of torrenting. The company also stresses that the activity it identified was unauthorized and unrelated to its AI training.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Meta Employees ‘Interacted’ With Pirated Copies of Adult Films, Filing Shows

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A Vietnamese court has sentenced 14 people who worked on the pirate football streaming site Bún Chả TV, handing out the first prison terms we've seen since the country's piracy crackdown began earlier this year. Eleven defendants received sentences ranging from eight to twelve months, while three commentators got suspended sentences. The alleged organizer of the group does not appear to be among those sentenced.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Vietnam Jails Pirate Football Streamers for Up to a Year, Three Escape Prison

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
When Funimation shut down in 2024, buyers of DVDs and Blu-ray discs that came with a Funimation digital release lost access to those copies. A fresh petition to the U.S. Copyright Office cites this as a reason for a DMCA exemption that would allow disc owners to make replacement copies for personal use. Rightsholders and other opponents of the proposal have until February to file their objections.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Funimation Shutdown Fuels Push for DMCA Exemption to Legally Rip Anime Content

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (gu3)
articles.description:
The ScummVM Team is pleased to announce that Hollywood Monsters, the 1997 point-and-click comedy adventure by Pendulo Studios, is ready for public testing!
In a world where the monsters of the silver screen aren't special effects but real-life stars, Frankenstein's monster, the Mummy, Dracula and friends are working actors. Every year the industry honors them at the glamorous Hollywood Monsters awards gala. Reporters Ron Ashman and Sue Bergman of The Quill are sent to cover the ceremony, but when Sue vanishes while chasing a much bigger story, it's up to Ron to follow the trail from the backlots of Hollywood to Scotland, Switzerland, Australia and beyond.
Hollywood Monsters is a classic verb-based adventure full of absurd characters, affectionate parodies of the golden age of monster movies, and puzzles that range from inventory combinations to conversations with bizarre characters.
The game was only ever released in Spanish and Italian, but that's no longer a language barrier: ScummVM includes a complete set of English subtitles, so you can now enjoy Ron and Sue's adventure.
For this testing period, ScummVM supports the Spanish and Italian original releases, as well as the corresponding demos. As usual, you will need the original game data files to play.
To join the test, grab a recent daily development build, add your game directory to ScummVM, and play through the game. Please report any problems you encounter on our issue tracker, following our bug submission guidelines. Screenshots and saved games demonstrating an issue are always helpful.
Are you ready to get the scoop of the century?
>
articles.title: Extra, extra! Tonight is Hollywood Monsters!

articles.description: OpenTTD 16.0-RC1 is now ready for testing with some minor bugfixes. With a release candidate, the focus shifts from adding new features to finding and fixing bugs to make OpenTTD 16 the best yet. The finding part is where you, the players, come in, too. If there’s anything you notice, head over to our issue tracker and make a report. Some minor changes over the previous beta5 release are: Updated OpenTTD TTF fonts to v0.9 Fixed inconsistent rail station coverage area highlight behaviour. Fixed uncommanded movement step after an end of line reverse could lead to path reservation problems or train crashes. Fixed uneven autoroad hotspot. As always, see the changelog for the full list. Download Changelog Bug tracker
articles.title: OpenTTD 16.0-RC1

Divačka: "Základní speciální."

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Jediným "tahákem" tohoto filmu je Johnny Depp. Vypadá jinak než ho známe, ale když pomine počáteční překvapení, jeho herecký výkon příliš nefunguje a kontraproduktivně se pitvoří, jako kdyby hrál na školní besídce. Pokud mi většina Marvel produkce připadá nudná a stále se opakující, co mám pak říct o téhle mnohem lacinější, mnohem hůře zrežírované a hůře zahrané kopii Doctora Strange? articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Zajímavá forma, kombinující dokument, metadokument, komedii a možná několik dalších žánrů. Bohužel, přes svou téměř tříhodinovou délku nám film nesdělí o mnoho více informací, než "Ti dva lidi jsou asi magoři, možná dokonce nebezpeční magoři, ale kdo ví". Zbytečně mnoho času je věnováno scénám, jejichž jediným účelem je pouze aktéry zesměšnit pomocí sugestivního střihu, podobně jako v Boratovi. Jsou vtipné, ale v rozporu se zbytkem filmu. (Ilča 50 %)

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Je nutno ocenit řemeslnou stránku filmu a nasazení (nebo spíš posedlost) jeho tvůrců, kteří mohli identický film natočit snáze a laciněji. Ale výsledek je převážně nekonečná sekvence pohádkových a fantasy klišé, aniž by nějaká postava nebo podzápletka byla originální nebo zajímavá (té nejzajímavější, ohledně oprávněnosti konání hlavní padoušky, je věnovaná necelá minuta). Takže něco jako "Kroniky Narnie" nebo "Labyrinth" z 80. let, ale uvidíme umřít o něco více postav. (Ilča 40 %)

articles.description: Téměř dokonalé. Dva a půl skvělých herců, vypilovaný chytrý scénář, bezchybná režie. articles.description:
Dnes to bude takové delší zamyšlení ohledně překládání filmů (a překládání obecně), které začalo e-mailem.
Ten e-mail poslal pan Stanislav Havelek (kterého neznám) do distribuční společnosti Falcon a stěžoval si v něm na to, že letošní film Resident Evil má zbytečně vulgární české titulky. Protože jsem film překládal já, Falcon se mě zeptal, jestli se k tomu chci nějak vyjádřit, já se nějak stručně vyjádřil a Falcon na základě mého vyjádření a svých informací nějak odpověděl panu Havelkovi. Tyto e-maily zde nebudu publikovat, protože všechny ústřední myšlenky v nich obsažené budou duplikované v následujícím textu, a to v detailnější podobě.



Pan Havelek se totiž nespokojil s odpovědí Falconu (která se nesla ve smyslu "S Fukovým překladem nemáme problém") a napsal o den později e-mail pří…
articles.title: Resident Evil: Kde končí věrnost originálu a začíná zbytečná vulgarizace překladu?

articles.description:
It was discovered that OAuthLib incorrectly handled JSONP callback
parameters in the token revocation endpoint. A remote attacker could
possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code in a client
application. (CVE-2026-49264)

Elvin Latifli discovered that OAuthLib incorrectly compared PKCE code
verifiers, using a comparison that was not constant-time. A remote
attacker could possibly use this issue to obtain access tokens,
resulting in an account takeover. This issue only affected Ubuntu 26.10,
Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 20.04
LTS. (CVE-2026-49265)

Strick Sheng discovered that OAuthLib incorrectly validated the client
identity. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to obtain
tokens authorized under another client, bypassing token authorization.
(CVE-2026-118669)

Kyle Hekhuis discovered that OAuthLib incorrectly validated device codes
in the device authorization workflow. A remote attacker could possibly
use this issue to obtain a token without completing device authorization.
This issue only affected Ubuntu 26.10 and Ubuntu 26.04 LTS.
(CVE-2026-49272)
articles.title: USN-9188-1: OAuthLib vulnerabilities

articles.description:
Haruto Kimura, Rinku Das, and Yi Lin discovered that libssh did not
correctly handle SSH channel open messages advertising a zero maximum
packet size. An authenticated user could possibly use this issue to cause
libssh to use excessive resources, leading to a denial of service. This
issue only affected Ubuntu 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, and
Ubuntu 20.04 LTS. (CVE-2026-59843)

Mikhail Ilin and Saransh Rana discovered that libssh did not correctly
sanitize shell metacharacters when expanding usernames in ProxyCommand
strings. An attacker could possibly use this issue to obtain sensitive
information. (CVE-2026-59846)

Ben Smyth discovered that libssh incorrectly verified AES-GCM
authentication tags when built with the OpenSSL backend. A remote attacker
in a machine-in-the-middle position could possibly use this issue to modify
encrypted traffic without detection. This issue only affected Ubuntu 20.04
LTS. (CVE-2026-59847)

It was discovered that libssh did not correctly handle SFTP server
responses for unknown request IDs. A remote attacker controlling a
malicious SFTP server could possibly use this issue to cause libssh to use
excessive resources, leading to a denial of service. (CVE-2026-59848)

Zhou Qingyang discovered that libssh could invoke data callbacks on
channels after they had been closed, leading to a use-after-free. A remote
attacker could possibly use this issue to cause libssh to crash, resulting
in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. This issue only
affected Ubuntu 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 20.04 LTS.
(CVE-2026-59850)
articles.title: USN-9187-1: libssh vulnerabilities
